description: Declare or clear the current task scope so ThumbGate can compare affected files and diffs against the approved path set.

allowedPaths.description: Glob patterns that define the allowed file scope for this task

clear.description: Clear the current task scope instead of setting one

localOnly.description: When true, also marks the task as local-only

protectedPaths.description: Optional protected-file globs that require explicit approval before editing or publishing

repoPath.description: Optional repo root used when evaluating git diff scope

summary.description: Short summary of the task being worked

taskId.description: Optional stable task identifier (ticket, issue, or work item id)

ttlMs.description: Optional lease length in milliseconds. With it the scope becomes time-bounded authority (e.g. 90000 for "write under ./src for 90 seconds") and FAILS CLOSED on expiry: a lapsed lease authorises nothing until renewed. Omit for a permanent scope. Clamped to 60s..24h.

workflowContract.description: Optional deterministic workflow run contract. Supports workflowId, allowedBranches, blockedActions, requiredEvidence, and completionGate.

name: set_task_scope
title: Set Task Scope
